title: Coverage Finding
description: Part XCVI: a capability-regression coverage finding -- whether a named field/usage the pre-migration ('legacy') code actually referenced is still referenced, with a compatible shape, in the Zone I implementation. Never a bare pass/fail: see src/cleanroom/coverage.py's module docstring for what this grep-based check does and does not catch.

name.description: The referenced field/identifier name this finding is about.

status.description: 'present': referenced by name in both. 'missing': referenced in legacy usage, never found under this name in Zone I -- a candidate dropped capability. 'divergent': present in both, but Zone I appears not to apply a value-conversion convention the legacy code consistently applied to this field.

confidence.description: CONFIRMED: the underlying name-based presence/absence fact is deterministic (not a claim the finding is definitely a real bug). PLAUSIBLE: a convention-consistency signal requiring human review, never auto-failed. insufficient_evidence: the extractor found nothing to check (see 'overall_status' in the coverage report).
